description:
REF: 0602L: CANDLEMAKER ROW

 

Fantastic, 1 bedroom flat located on Candlemaker Row, one of Edinburgh's most historic streets, overlooking Greyfriars Bobby Kirk and perfectly located for access to the Grassmarket. The area provides an abundance of restaurants, cafes, bars and eateries and Princes Street, George Stree and The Meadows are only moments away on foot. Both Edinburgh University and the National Museum of Scotland are within a two minute walk.

 

The 2nd floor property is tastefully decorated in neutral tones throughout and would be ideal for students or professionals.  It is available FURNISHED and features:

~Open-plan lounge/kitchen with neutral décor and leather sofas

~Kitchen features selection of modern appliances and plentiful storage

~Double bedroom with carpeted flooring and neutral décor

~Contemporary shower room with three-piece suite

~Entrance hallway providing access to all rooms

~Original sash and case windows

~Electric heating

~Secure entry

~Sorry, no pets

~Total floor area = 33m²

~Council tax: band C

~EPC rating: D

 

Available: 30th September 2026

 

Rent: £995pcm

Deposit: £995

 

Please note the photographs shown within this advertisement may have been taken whilst a tenancy was active in the property and as a result you should not rely only on these as an accurate representation of furnishings and items included in the agreement. A full list of which items are included in the property is available upon request from our office, based on a previous tenancy. A viewing is therefore required in order to ensure you have an accurate understanding and knowledge of the condition and contents of the property.

 

Property Reference:

0602L EDI CR
